raw_segments.text: Fourthly, farmers and country laborers can no more augment, without parsimony, the real
revenue, the annual produce of the land and labor of their society, than artificers, manufacturers,
The annual produce of the land and labor of any society can be augmented only in two ways.
Either first, by some improvement in the productive powers of the useful labor actually maintained
within it, or secondly, by some increase in the quantity of that labor.
For more information, please visit www.fema.gov
